paite: Bangchidana dangkaeng mial ahia! bangchidana dangkaeng siangthou penpen lamdangta ahia! Kongzing chiteng tungah munsiangthou suangte sunkhiak ahi.
english: How the gold has become dim! The most pure gold has changed! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of every street.

paite: Zion tapa manphate, dangkaeng hoih toh tehpih theih, bangchidana leibel, belvelmi khutnasepbanga ngaih hita ahia!
english: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, How are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!

paite: Sehalte nasanin a nawi uh a suah ua, ata tuailaite uh a tepsak uh: ka mite tanu jaw honggiloua, gamdai vasa mulneilou bangin.
english: Even the jackals draw out the breast, they nurse their young ones: The daughter of my people has become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.

paite: Nawitep lai naupang lai dangtak jiakin a kam dangtawngah a belha: naupang tuailaiten tanghou a ngen ua, amah dingin kuamahin a balkham kei uh.
english: The tongue of the nursing child clings to the roof of his mouth for thirst: The young children ask bread, and no man breaks it to them.

paite: Nuam taka nete kongzing khawngah a mangthang uh: puansandupa khanglianten ekvut a kawi uh.
english: Those who fed delicately are desolate in the streets: Those who were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.

paite: Ka mite tanu gitlouhna lah Sodom khelhna sangin a thupizo ngala, huai bel mitphiat kallouin a kizoua, amah tungah khut a kinga kei hi.
english: For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the sin of Sodom, That was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands were laid on her.

paite: A miliante vuk sangin a siangthou jaw ua, nawitui sangin a ngou jaw uh, suangmantam sandup sangin a pumpi uah a sandup jaw ua, a tetna uh a saphir suangmantam bang ahi:
english: Her nobles were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk; They were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was as of sapphire.

paite: A mel uh suangkuangthei sangin a vom jaw a: kongzingtea theihin a om kei uh: a vun uh a guh uah a belh bikbeka; a keua, chiangkang a bang.
english: Their appearance is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: Their skin clings to their bones; it is withered, it has become like a stick.

paite: Namsaua thaha om dingte kiala thaha om dingte sangina hoihjaw uh; gama gahte duh jiakin hiaite lah a gawng gawp un, nakpiin a se khin uh.
english: Those who are killed with the sword are better than those who are killed with hunger; For these pine away, stricken through, for want of the fruits of the field.

paite: Hehpihthei numei khutten amau tate a huan ua, ka mite tanu hihsiatna ah a an uh ahi.
english: The hands of the pitiful women have boiled their own children; They were their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

paite: TOUPAN a thangpaihna a hihpichingta, a hehna mahmah a sung khiaa; Zion ah mei a toha, huaiin huaia suangphumte a suse vek hi.
english: Yahweh has accomplished his wrath, he has poured out his fierce anger; He has kindled a fire in Zion, which has devoured its foundations.

paite: Leia kumpipaten a um kei ua, khovel a tengtengin leng, Jerusalem kongpi sungah gal leh melma a lut ding uh chih.
english: The kings of the earth didn’t believe, neither all the inhabitants of the world, That the adversary and the enemy would enter into the gates of Jerusalem.

paite: A jawlneite khelhna jiak leh a siampute ginatlouhna jiak ahi, huchibanga a lak taka midikte sisan suah a a om.
english: It is because of the sins of her prophets, and the iniquities of her priests, That have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her.

paite: Mitto mite bangin kongzing khawngah a vakvai ua, sisana suknitin a om ua, huchiin miten a puante uh a lawng kei uh.
english: They wander as blind men in the streets, they are polluted with blood, So that men can’t touch their garments.

paite: Pai mang un, Nin! pai mang un, pai mang un, lawng kei un, chiin amau a kikou khum ua: a tai mang ua, a vialvak lai un, miten namte lakah, hiai ah a om nawn kei ding uh, a chi uh.
english: Depart! they cried to them, Unclean! depart, depart, don’t touch! When they fled away and wandered, men said among the nations, They shall not live here any more.

paite: TOUPA hehnain amaute a hawmjaka; amaute a limsak nawnta kei ding: siampute mina a zahtak kei ua, upate a deihsak kei uh.
english: The anger of Yahweh has scattered them; he will no more regard them: They didn’t respect the persons of the priests, they didn’t favor the elders.

paite: I mitte I panpihna juau sosan lametna ah a vaikhina: I ngakna uah nam hondam theilou ding I na ngak ta ua.
english: Our eyes still fail, looking in vain for our help: In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save.

paite: I kongzingte ua i pai theih louhna dingin, I kalsuante a zong ua: I tawp uh a naia, I nite a kimta: I tawp uh lah a hongtungta.
english: They hunt our steps, so that we can’t go in our streets: Our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end has come.

paite: Vana muvanlaite sangin ei hondelhte a man-gangjaw uh: mual tungahte a hon delh ua, gamdaiah a honna buak uh.
english: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the sky: They chased us on the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.

paite: I nakvangte hu, TOUPA thaunilh, a kokhuk ua lakin a om ua; amah thu genin. Alim nuaia namte lakah hing ding, I chi ua.
english: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of Yahweh, was taken in their pits; Of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the nations.

paite: Nuamsa inla kipakin Aw Edom tanu. Uz gama teng: nou lah nang phain leng a hongpai suak ding; na kham dinga vuaktangin na kibawl ding.Aw zion tanu, na thulimlouhna gawtna zoh a hita; saltanna ah nang a honpi mang nawnta kei ding: na thulimlouhna a hongveh ding, Aw Edom tanu; na khelhnate a mukhe dinghi
english: Rejoice and be glad, daughter of Edom, that dwell in the land of Uz: The cup shall pass through to you also; you shall be drunken, and shall make yourself naked.

paite: Aw zion tanu, na thulimlouhna gawtna zoh a hita; saltanna ah nang a honpi mang nawnta kei ding: na thulimlouhna a hongveh ding, Aw Edom tanu; na khelhnate a mukhe dinghi
english: The punishment of your iniquity is accomplished, daughter of Zion; he will no more carry you away into captivity: He will visit your iniquity, daughter of Edom; he will uncover your sins.
